title: Model-specific runtime optimizations: Llama/Mistral/Qwen quirks + GQA/MQA tuning
author: Asha Kapoor
description: Motivation: reduce per-token cost and tail latency for a set of high-priority open models by adding model-specific kernel selection, scheduling tweaks, and quantization-profile tuning. This PR implements targeted fixes for Llama rotary math edge-cases, Mistral RMSNorm numerics on fused kernels, and Qwen ALiBi/frequency bias handling under MQA/GQA quantization. It also adds a new set of GQA/MQA quantization profiles with safer fallbacks and a scheduler hint that prioritizes small-latency-sensitive requests in continuous batching. The description covers what changed, why, and how we validated it. Key changes: 1) kernel_selector: add model hints and runtime probe to prefer specialized rotary/attention kernels for Llama and to avoid pathological kernel on short sequences; 2) scheduler: add latency-priority hint + fallback window to improve tail latency for chat-like workloads while preserving batching efficiency; 3) kv_cache: reduce overhead of slot metadata and fix eviction logic that caused cache corruption for interleaved MQA streams; 4) quant_profiles: add gqa_mqa.toml with tuned scales and safe-fallback flags; 5) model adapters: small fixes for Mistral RMSNorm fused op and Qwen ALiBi offsets. Testing: unit tests for kv_cache eviction and kernel selector probes, integration perf harness runs for 8 representative workloads, stress tests for concurrent MQA streams. Results: median throughput +12% across workloads and up to +18% for Qwen-70B at 512 tokens, tail (95p) latency improved 8-20% depending on sequence length. Rollout plan: gradual canary on Dedicated then host API; new quant profiles opt-in via config flag and fall back to current profiles on mismatch. Backcompat: no breaking API changes. See release notes for flags and recommended tuning steps.

review_comments: Kai Nguyen (review): Can you add a microbenchmark that isolates the new kernel selection probe? We need numbers across batch=1..16 for validation.
Author (Asha): Added perf harness scenarios and included a microbenchmark in tests/perf. See commits g7b9c3d and h1c2d3e.
Marta Lopez (review): The kv_cache change looks correct but please add a unit test for eviction under interleaved token streams to prevent regressions.
Author (Asha): Added unit test and a stress mode that ran overnight on perf-canary; results attached to the PR artifacts.
Devon Chan (review): Will this change the default quant profile behavior on Hosted? We should not surprise tenants.
Author (Asha): Quant profiles are opt-in via config flag 'runtime.quant_profiles.mqa_gqa.enabled' and fall back to stable profiles if mismatched. Updated docs accordingly.
release_notes: Added model-specific kernel selection and scheduler tweaks improving throughput and tail latency for Llama, Mistral, and Qwen. Introduced GQA/MQA quantization profiles with safe fallbacks. No API changes; quant profiles are opt-in. See docs/runtime/quant_profiles for migration steps.
perf_summary: Median throughput +12% across representative workloads; Qwen-70B up to +18% at 512 tokens. Tail latency (95p) improvements between 8-20% depending on sequence length. KV cache memory overhead reduced ~6%. Detailed benchmark CSVs attached to CI artifacts.
notes_for_ops: Canary rollout steps: (1) enable runtime.quant_profiles.mqa_gqa.enabled=false by default, (2) enable on a limited Dedicated pool with telemetry exported to tracing:runtime.quant_profile, (3) monitor token-level error rate and tail latency for 48h, (4) flip flag for broader rollout if stable.
backcompat_notes: No breaking API changes. New quant profiles are opt-in and include safe fallback behavior. Existing workloads continue to use current profiles unless explicitly opted in.
test_plan: Unit tests for kv_cache eviction and kernel selector probe; integration perf runs across 8 workloads with continuous batching and interleaved MQA streams; overnight stress run on perf-canary. All tests green in CI except a flaky lint job that was retried.
notes: Follow-up items tracked in ENG-9032: extend kernel probe to other model families and add dynamic kernel warm-up on cold-start paths.
